snippet.title: Versebound - Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Versebound 1.0 is officially OUT NOW! 
Enjoy the full game with a new map, weapons, unlocks, characters, rituals and much more!
You can get the game with a 10% discount during the first week of the launch.

Get the game on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2672520/Versebound/

Versebound is a challenging action roguelike bullet heaven set in a world inspired by Finnish folk epic Kalevala.

Unlock words of power and fight to unshackle your fate in mythic Kalevala! Slay hordes of enemies, overcome bullet hell bosses and challenging trials while exploring handcrafted environments. Learn from every defeat and craft your optimal build to rewrite your saga. Here, verses wield power!

Store page: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2672520/Versebound/
Follow our progress on Discord:
